verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted platform that exposes APIs (API keys, a gateway API reference), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, runnable API explorer. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate docs path, and the gateway reference page is only static documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
